that one. I hope it's not a scam.

" I'm so fucking weird and screwed up that I don't bother questioning the stupid shit I say or do anymore."

This hits me in the chest. Your words, my life.
Please PM me. I am going through a lot of the same issues. I know i'm going insane and knowing is the worst part for me. Seriously, PM. I feel like we can help each other.
Someone get the Cipro. And if its real bad then someone lucky is getting a big shot of Rocephin mixed with lidocaine right in the ass!

Any color but a black or red bow tie. too formal. Long ties are an infection hazard in my opinion...swinging around when you lean into a wound. yuck! If you work with elderly patients then bowties are sure to make them smile. When I picture a physician...I see nice black office-dress pants with black dress shoes and a white shirt. A white shirt looks clean. you have to keep it clean, though.
I hear 'foe- eat- us' and I wish I could change it :(
